Sample Session: Full Body + Core

About 50–55 min · Machines first · Built around your PT program

0%On phoneOffline ✓
Safety first: Mild muscle soreness is normal. If you get back pain beyond normal soreness, like sharp, pinching, or radiating pain, or that familiar upper/mid-back pain coming back, stop that exercise and check with your PT before doing it again. No hip hinges or RDLs for now.
How to use this page
  • Swipe each exercise’s photos to see the movement; the last slide is the video. Tap it to play, or use the red button to open YouTube. Tap Set buttons as you finish each set. Your progress is saved on this phone.
  • Weight rule: pick a weight where you finish each set feeling like you could do 2–3 more good reps. If you could do 5+ more, go up next set.
  • Write down the weight/pin number for each machine so we can progress next time.
  • Afterward, tell me how it felt, what was too easy/hard, and anything sore.

Warmup

~8 min · get warm, loosen the back

1

Stationary bike

5 min easy
Target weight: Light, see weight note below
Rest: —

Swipe for photos → video

Weight: Easy pace. You can hold a conversation. Light resistance.

  • Seat at hip height so your knee is slightly bent at the bottom
  • Sit tall, relax shoulders away from ears
  • Spin smooth, gradually pick up the pace in the last minute

2

Cat cow (PT)

1 x 10 slow reps
Target weight: Light, see weight note below
Rest: —

Swipe for photos → video

▶ Open video in YouTube

Weight: Bodyweight. Move within a comfortable range.

  • Hands under shoulders, knees under hips
  • Breathe in as you drop the belly and lift the chest; breathe out as you round the back
  • Move slow, one segment of the spine at a time

3

Modified prone press-up (PT)

1 x 10
Target weight: Light, see weight note below
Rest: —

Swipe for photos → video

▶ Open video in YouTube

Weight: Bodyweight. Do your PT's modified version (e.g. on forearms) if that's what they gave you.

  • Lie face down, hands under shoulders
  • Press the upper body up, keep hips and legs relaxed on the floor
  • Stop at a comfortable stretch, no pinching

PT core block

~12 min · your PT program, done while you're fresh

4

Resisted dead bug

3 sets × 10/side
Target weight: Light, see weight note below
Rest: 30–45 sec

Swipe for photos → video

▶ Open video in YouTube

Weight: Same band as your home program. Slow and controlled beats heavy.

  • Low back gently pressed into the floor the whole time
  • Breathe out as you reach the opposite arm and leg away
  • If your back arches, shorten the reach

Search YouTube for more demos →

5

Bird dog dumbbell row

3 sets × 10/side
Target weight: Light, see weight note below
Rest: 30–45 sec

Swipe for photos → video

▶ Open video in YouTube

Weight: 10–12 lb dumbbell, per your PT.

  • Hips level, like balancing a cup of water on your low back
  • Row the weight to your hip, elbow close to your side
  • Don't twist toward the weight

Search YouTube for more demos →

6

Standing anti-rotation (Pallof) press

3 sets × 10/side
Target weight: Light, see weight note below
Rest: 30 sec

Swipe for photos → video

▶ Open video in YouTube

Weight: Band or cable at chest height. Pick a level where you can stay perfectly still.

Alternatives: Band Pallof press, or half-kneeling Pallof press

  • Stand side-on to the anchor, feet hip-width, knees soft
  • Press hands straight out from your chest and hold 2 sec
  • Resist the pull, don't let your torso rotate

Search YouTube for more demos →

7

Side plank clamshell

3 sets × 10/side
Target weight: Light, see weight note below
Rest: 30–45 sec

Swipe for photos → video

▶ Open video in YouTube

Weight: Bodyweight, add a band above the knees once it's easy.

  • Elbow under shoulder, knees bent, hips lifted in a straight line
  • Open the top knee without rolling the hips back
  • Keep breathing, don't hold your breath

Machine strength

~25 min · full body, machines only

8

Leg press

3 sets × 10 reps
Target weight: Light, see weight note below
Rest: 90 sec

Swipe for photos → video

▶ Open video in YouTube

Weight: Start light and add weight until 10 reps feels like you could do 2–3 more. Write the weight down.

Alternatives: Hack squat machine, or goblet squat to a box

  • Feet shoulder-width, mid-platform
  • Lower until knees are about 90°, keep low back and hips flat against the pad
  • Push through your whole foot, don't lock your knees at the top

Search YouTube for more demos →

9

Seated leg curl

3 sets × 10 reps
Target weight: Light, see weight note below
Rest: 60–90 sec

Swipe for photos → video

▶ Open video in YouTube

Weight: Light to start; finish each set with 2–3 reps left in the tank.

Alternatives: No seated curl at the Y: lying leg curl machine, or stability-ball hamstring curl

  • Line your knee up with the machine's pivot point
  • Lap pad snug on your thighs, back against the seat
  • Curl down, then return slowly (about 2–3 sec)

Search YouTube for more demos →

10

Lat pulldown

3 sets × 10 reps
Target weight: Light, see weight note below
Rest: 90 sec

Swipe for photos → video

▶ Open video in YouTube

Weight: Pick a weight you can pull to your upper chest without leaning back much. Leave 2–3 reps in reserve.

Alternatives: Assisted pull-up machine, or cable straight-arm pulldown

  • Thigh pad snug, grip a little wider than shoulders
  • Chest up, pull the bar to your upper chest, elbows down and back
  • Control it on the way up, don't let the weight yank you

Search YouTube for more demos →

11

Seated cable row (or row machine)

3 sets × 10 reps
Target weight: Light, see weight note below
Rest: 90 sec

Swipe for photos → video

▶ Open video in YouTube

Weight: Moderate. You should be able to pause 1 sec at your stomach every rep.

Alternatives: Seated row machine, chest-supported row machine, or single-arm cable row

  • Sit tall, slight knee bend, chest up. Don't round your back
  • Pull the handle to your belly button, squeeze shoulder blades together
  • Don't rock your torso back and forth to move the weight

Search YouTube for more demos →

12

Chest press machine

3 sets × 10 reps
Target weight: Light, see weight note below
Rest: 90 sec

Swipe for photos → video

▶ Open video in YouTube

Weight: Start light and add weight until 10 reps leaves 2–3 in the tank.

Alternatives: Cable chest press, incline chest press machine, or push-ups on a bench

  • Set the seat so the handles are at mid-chest
  • Back and head on the pad, shoulders down
  • Press out without locking your elbows, return slowly

Search YouTube for more demos →

13

Glute bridge (or hip thrust machine)

3 sets × 10 reps
Target weight: Light, see weight note below
Rest: 60 sec

Swipe for photos → video

▶ Open video in YouTube

Weight: Bodyweight bridge first. Once 10 is easy, use the hip thrust machine or a dumbbell on your hips.

Alternatives: Glute bridge on the floor, or cable pull-through only if your PT okays a hinge

  • Feet flat, about hip-width, heels close to your butt
  • Squeeze your glutes to lift. Ribs down, don't arch your low back
  • Pause 1–2 sec at the top, lower slowly

Alt video: Hip thrust machine demo: How to Hip Thrust Machine (Level Up Fitness)

Finisher

~10 min · burn some extra calories

14

Incline treadmill walk (or bike intervals)

10 min
Target weight: Light, see weight note below
Rest: —

Swipe for photos → video

▶ Open video in YouTube

Weight: Treadmill: 3.0–3.5 mph at 5–10% incline, breathing hard but able to talk. Bike option: 30 sec hard / 90 sec easy x 5.

Alternatives: Bike, elliptical, or stair climber at an easy-moderate pace

  • Don't hold the handrails, swing your arms
  • Stand tall, don't lean forward into the hill
  • Cool down for the last 1–2 min
